title: Alert v1
description: Value of messages on topic ops.alerts.v1 (A-0003): one firing alert per message, UTF-8 JSON, at most incident.alerts.max-payload-bytes (default 65536) bytes. Unknown properties are ignored and not stored. Invalid messages go to ops.alerts.v1.dlq with the reason in header dead-letter-reason.

source.description: System that raised the alert, for example prometheus.

fingerprint.description: Identity of the alert within the source. Alerts with the same source and fingerprint belong to the same open incident.

severity.description: Severity as reported by the source; triage assigns its own.

service.description: Affected service as reported by the source.

generatorUrl.description: Link to the alert in the source system.
